description: Defines classes and methods for establishing HTTP proxy connections, including proxy socket parameters and connection job management, with support for different proxy types and authentication.

classes.name: HttpProxySocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for proxy socket connections, including transport and SSL parameters, proxy endpoint, and proxy type.

classes.name: HttpProxyConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of establishing a connection through an HTTP proxy, including handling different proxy protocols, authentication, and timeouts.

methods.name: is_quic
methods.description: Indicates if the proxy connection uses QUIC.

methods.name: tunnel
methods.description: Indicates if the connection is a tunnel.

methods.name: HttpProxyConnectJob
methods.description: Constructor for initiating a proxy connection job.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the connection job.

methods.name: HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Checks if a connection has been established.

methods.name: IsSSLError
methods.description: Checks if the error is SSL-related.

methods.name: OnConnectJobComplete
methods.description: Callback when a connect job completes.

methods.name: AlternateNestedConnectionTimeout
methods.description: Calculates connection timeout based on network conditions.

methods.name: TunnelTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for establishing a tunnel.

methods.name: UpdateFieldTrialParametersForTesting
methods.description: Updates timeout parameters based on field trials.
